pharm: Stimulates soluble guanylate cyclase, both sensitizing it to endogenous nitric oxide and directly activating it independently of NO, increasing cyclic GMP to produce pulmonary and systemic vasodilation
quick: Start 1 mg three times daily; titrate by 0.5 mg every >=2 weeks to max 2.5 mg three times daily
May be taken with or without food; food does not affect bioavailability
Contraindicated - boxed warning for embryo-fetal toxicity; REMS with pregnancy testing
Not recommended if CrCl below 15 mL/min or on dialysis
Not recommended in severe (Child-Pugh C) impairment
No specific interaction described; additive hypotension possible
Blood pressure, signs of hypotension, bleeding, pregnancy tests (females)
summary: Riociguat (Adempas) is a soluble guanylate cyclase stimulator indicated for adults with persistent/recurrent or inoperable chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension (CTEPH, WHO Group 4) and with pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH, WHO Group 1) to improve exercise capacity and WHO functional class and delay clinical worsening. It carries a boxed warning for embryo-fetal toxicity and is available to females only through the Adempas REMS. It is started at 1 mg three times daily and titrated to a maximum of 2.5 mg three times daily, with care to avoid hypotension; it is contraindicated with nitrates, PDE-5 inhibitors, and other sGC stimulators.
indications: Persistent/recurrent chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension (CTEPH, WHO Group 4) after surgical treatment, or inoperable CTEPH, to improve exercise capacity and WHO functional class
Pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH, WHO Group 1) to improve exercise capacity, improve WHO functional class, and delay clinical worsening

dosage.d: Start 1 mg three times daily; if SBP >95 mmHg and no hypotension, up-titrate by 0.5 mg three times daily no sooner than every 2 weeks; max 2.5 mg three times daily
dosage.n: If symptoms of hypotension occur, decrease by 0.5 mg three times daily

dosage.d: Consider starting at 0.5 mg three times daily
dosage.n: Also consider 0.5 mg starting dose with strong CYP and P-gp/BCRP inhibitors

dosage.d: Consider titrating above 2.5 mg three times daily if tolerated
dosage.n: A dose decrease may be needed if the patient stops smoking; safety/efficacy above 2.5 mg not established

dosage.d: Not recommended if CrCl below 15 mL/min or on dialysis, or in Child-Pugh C hepatic impairment
dosage.n: No clinically relevant effect of age, sex, weight, or race on PK

admin: Take orally three times daily, with or without food
Tablets may be crushed and mixed with water or soft foods (e.g. applesauce) immediately before use if swallowing is difficult
Separate from antacids by at least 1 hour
If a dose is missed, continue with the next scheduled dose; if interrupted for 3 days or more, re-titrate
Females: dispense only through the Adempas REMS program with pregnancy testing
moa: Riociguat is a stimulator of soluble guanylate cyclase (sGC), the receptor for nitric oxide (NO). It has a dual mode of action: it sensitizes sGC to endogenous NO by stabilizing NO-sGC binding, and it directly stimulates sGC via a different binding site independently of NO. This increases generation of cyclic GMP, leading to vasodilation. The active metabolite (M1) is about 1/3 to 1/10 as potent as riociguat.

absolute: Concomitant use of nitrates or nitric oxide donors (e.g. amyl nitrite) in any form
Concomitant use of PDE-5 inhibitors (sildenafil, tadalafil, vardenafil) or nonspecific PDE inhibitors (dipyridamole, theophylline)
Concomitant use of other soluble guanylate cyclase stimulators
Pulmonary hypertension associated with idiopathic interstitial pneumonias (PH-IIP)
relative: Hypovolemia, severe left ventricular outflow obstruction, resting hypotension, autonomic dysfunction (hypotension risk)
Concomitant antihypertensives or strong CYP and P-gp/BCRP inhibitors
Conditions predisposing to bleeding; pulmonary veno-occlusive disease
monitor: Blood pressure and signs/symptoms of hypotension
Pregnancy tests before, monthly during, and 1 month after treatment in females of reproductive potential

preg: BOXED WARNING - embryo-fetal toxicity. Riociguat is contraindicated in pregnancy; based on animal reproduction studies it may cause fetal harm and miscarriage (teratogenic and embryotoxic in rats; abortions and fetal toxicity in rabbits). Exclude pregnancy before starting, monthly during treatment, and 1 month after stopping. Females of reproductive potential must use effective contraception during treatment and for one month after the last dose, and can only receive the drug through the Adempas REMS program.
lact: There are no data on the presence of riociguat in human milk or its effects on the breastfed infant or milk production. Because of the potential for serious adverse reactions, advise patients not to breastfeed during treatment.
renal: Riociguat is not recommended in patients with creatinine clearance below 15 mL/min or on dialysis. Patients with renal impairment had higher exposure; monitor for hypotension.
hepatic: Riociguat is not recommended in patients with severe (Child-Pugh C) hepatic impairment. Patients with hepatic impairment had higher exposure.

major: Nitrates / nitric oxide donors (any form) - contraindicated; severe hypotension

PDE-5 inhibitors (sildenafil, tadalafil, vardenafil) and nonspecific PDE inhibitors (dipyridamole, theophylline) - contraindicated; do not give within 24 h of sildenafil, or 24 h before/48 h after tadalafil
Other soluble guanylate cyclase stimulators - contraindicated

Strong CYP and P-gp/BCRP inhibitors (azole antifungals e.g. ketoconazole, itraconazole; HIV protease inhibitors e.g. ritonavir) - increase exposure; start at 0.5 mg three times daily and monitor for hypotension
moderate: Antacids - reduce absorption; separate by at least 1 hour
interactions.food: Food does not affect bioavailability; may be taken with or without food
interactions.alcohol: No specific interaction described; additive blood-pressure lowering possible
interactions.diagnostics: Monitor blood pressure; pregnancy testing required in females of reproductive potential

serious: Pulmonary edema in patients with pulmonary veno-occlusive disease

monitoring: Blood pressure and signs/symptoms of hypotension, especially during titration
Pregnancy tests before, monthly during, and 1 month after treatment in females of reproductive potential (REMS)
WHO functional class and exercise capacity
counsel: Take exactly three times a day; you can take it with or without food
Do NOT use nitrates, erectile-dysfunction drugs (sildenafil, tadalafil, vardenafil), or other pulmonary-pressure stimulators with this medicine
If you feel lightheaded, dizzy, or faint, sit or lie down and tell your clinician
Females: this medicine can seriously harm a fetus - you must use effective contraception, take monthly pregnancy tests, and enroll in the REMS program
Tell your clinician if you smoke or stop smoking, as the dose may need adjusting
pk: Vasodilatory effects develop after dosing; clinical benefit over weeks of titration
Peak plasma concentrations within about 1.5 hours; absolute bioavailability ~94%
Terminal half-life about 12 hours in patients (about 7 hours in healthy subjects)
Three-times-daily dosing required; exposure reduced 50-60% in smokers
Store at 25 C (77 F); excursions permitted 15-30 C (59-86 F)
pearls: Boxed warning for embryo-fetal toxicity; females access only via the Adempas REMS with monthly pregnancy testing and mandatory contraception
Absolutely contraindicated with nitrates, PDE-5 inhibitors, and other sGC stimulators due to dangerous hypotension
Smoking induces CYP1A1 and reduces riociguat exposure by 50-60%; smokers may need higher doses and a dose decrease on quitting
Titrate slowly (0.5 mg increments no sooner than every 2 weeks) guided by systolic BP >95 mmHg and absence of hypotensive symptoms
Contraindicated in pulmonary hypertension associated with idiopathic interstitial pneumonias (PH-IIP)
missed: If a dose is missed, continue with the next regularly scheduled dose - do not double up. If riociguat is interrupted for 3 days or more, it must be re-titrated starting at the lower dose.
overdose: In cases of overdose, blood pressure should be closely monitored and supported as appropriate (hypotension is the main concern). Based on extensive plasma protein binding (~95%), riociguat is not expected to be dialyzable.
